title: An n-covector on ℝ^P is determined by its increasing-basis coordinates (Simon 6.1.2)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let α, β ∈ Λ^n(ℝ^P) be n-covectors, i.e. continuous alternating n-linear maps (ℝ^P)^n → ℝ (Covector (Eucl P) n). For k ∈ Fin P let e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1. Suppose α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}) = β(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}), i.e. euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I = euclideanCovectorCoordinate β I, for every strictly increasing multi-index I ∈ SimonMultiIndex n P (an order embedding Fin n ↪o Fin P). Then α = β.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α β : Covector (Eucl P) n), (∀ I : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I = euclideanCovectorCoordinate β I) → α = β
